entities.name: Ludovic Booz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ludovic Booz was a Haitian painter and sculptor. Born in Aquin, Booz sculpted bronze busts of several Haitian presidents. His work has been exhibited in France, Israel, and Suriname.
